svg.title: Pastry Pirates — V3 · The Round Table — Recipe cards (21)
svg.desc: Every possible 5-of-7 recipe, exactly once — 21 cards, 64x38 mm. Deal two to each captain, keep one, as the app does. Units: mm. 25 mm squares, 6 mm material. No kerf compensation in this file — it is a design view; cut from the sheet-N files. RASTER = black fill (engrave), CUT = red hairline (cut). Generated by physical-board/generate.mjs.
